title: Super Theft Manual: Viceroy City
author: 3MusicLove3
selftext:
**Game Title:** Super Theft Manual: Viceroy City

**Playable Link:** [https://desisn.com/viceroycity/](https://desisn.com/viceroycity/)

A small game 10-15 minutes with top down graphics, you can drive your car around, do 4 (+2 bonus missions - watch for parked cars), spray paint your car, jump a bridge. It was just a quick try to see if I could make a longer game like this. I used AI to make it. It is basically a proof of concept. I originally wanted to develop it as a shader, so it is based on shader code.

**Free to Play Status:**

* \[x\] Free to play
* \[\] Demo/Key available
* \[ \] Paid

**Involvement:** I’m the developer. I designed and programmed the game AI assisted. AI was used on Sound, quick Illustration mockups for the various missions and the game mechanics.
